pages.title: Nutritional Debt
pages.text: Variety is not just rewarded — it is $(bold)enforced$().$(br2)If you over-rely on a single food group, Nourished applies $(c:#e05252)$(thing)nutritional debt$()(). Every time you eat from an already-saturated category, your most neglected nutrient bar slowly drains in the background.

pages.title: How It Triggers
pages.text: Debt kicks in when a single category's $(thing)recent eat count$() crosses a threshold — too much of the same group in a short window.$(br2)When it fires, Nourished finds whichever of your other bars is currently lowest and applies a small decay to it.$(br2)$(italic)Subtle but persistent. Ignore it long enough and you will see penalties in groups you thought were fine.$()

pages.title: Avoiding Debt
pages.text: $(bold)Eat a wider variety of foods.$()$(br2)Rotating between food groups prevents any single category from building up enough to trigger debt.$(br2)Players who maintain a genuinely balanced diet will $(italic)never notice it exists$().$(br2)The $(thing)Diet Screen$() shows your most neglected groups — use it to spot imbalances before debt starts working against you.
